title: Measure greatness by what the heart clings to
summary: This meets the envy that mistakes public size for true worth. The line says greatness belongs to the one whose attachment is fastened to the Lord.
takeaway: Call greatness by devotion, not display.
lifeApplication: Before comparing your place to someone else's, notice the body lean toward status. Ask what your heart is actually attached to before envy speaks.

source.shortMeaning: True greatness is loving attachment to the Lord, not to Maya's scale.
source.lifeApplication: When status enters the room, ask what your heart is serving before comparison hardens.

evidence.coreClaim: True greatness is loving attachment to the Lord, not to Maya's scale.
evidence.turn: Choose the Lord's measure of greatness and refuse Maya's scale.
